name: FiiO K17
author: homelabsealinsideout
description: Control a FiiO K17 DAC/amp over the network: volume, mute, input, EQ, a custom EQ editor with AutoEQ import and backups, optional volume-key control, and automatic switching to the K17 when it is in USB mode.

barWidget.description: Input, EQ, and volume of the FiiO K17 (your choice). Click for controls, scroll for volume, right-click to mute.

schema.label: IP address
schema.description: Network address of the K17 (Settings > About on the device).

schema.label: Show volume in the bar
schema.description: With none of input, EQ, and volume selected the bar shows a compact K17 label.

schema.label: Volume keys control the K17
schema.description: Needs the key bindings from the README. When the K17 is off or unreachable the keys fall back to the regular system volume.

schema.label: Volume limit for keys and scrolling
schema.description: Keys and scrolling never raise the volume above this. Levels set on the knob are left alone.

schema.label: Switch output to K17 USB
schema.description: Make the K17 the default output while its input is USB, and switch back to the previous output afterwards.

schema.label: Release connection for the FiiO app
schema.description: The K17 accepts one network client. Turn this on to let the FiiO Control app connect, and off again afterwards.
